description.value: Timmy Kitchen (添味馆) is a Chinese restaurant in the Steveston village area of Richmond, a popular cycling destination at the southern tip of Lulu Island. The restaurant offers dine-in service with outdoor seating and is wheelchair accessible. Its Steveston location puts it within easy reach of the waterfront dyke cycling routes that attract touring and recreational cyclists.
